failedAssertions.reason: baseline-report.json has synthetic TTFT and TPOT values stored as 0 due to an aggregation bug in generate_baseline_report.py. The raw individual benchmark JSON files (/root/benchmark-results/Qwen3.5-9B_synthetic_concurrency*.json and Llama-2-7b-hf_synthetic_concurrency*.json) contain correct TTFT/TPOT values. The fix is to update the generate_baseline_report.py script to correctly extract mean_ttft_ms and mean_tpot_ms from the vllm bench serve output JSON format and store them in the aggregated report.

appliedUpdates.description: Documented that stopping vLLM server leaves orphaned worker processes holding GPU VRAM; must kill worker PIDs via 'rocm-smi --showpids' after stopping API server process.
